### Props

| Name           | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `modelValue`   | `Array<object>` |          | `[]`    | The flows array (`v-model`) — `[{ name, trigger, actions[] }]`. Each flow MAY carry a `_layout` object of node positions, round-tripped by the serializer so a reload restores the canvas layout.                                   |
| `schema`       | `object`        |          | `null`  | The selected schema (for the field-name hint only).                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `eventCatalog` | `Array`         |          | `[]`    | The trigger event catalog from `GET /api/flow/event-catalog` (`[{ id, label, group, legacy? }]`). When empty, the builder falls back to the three legacy object-CRUD triggers so it still works offline / against an older backend. |
